letter-a.label: A
letter-a.hint: Point to the thumb tip of your passive hand (vowels run thumb → little finger).

letter-b.label: B
letter-b.hint: Both hands make a ring with thumb and index; the rings touch side by side.

letter-c.label: C
letter-c.hint: One hand only: curve thumb and index into a C.

letter-d.label: D
letter-d.hint: Curved thumb and index of the dominant hand against the upright index of the other hand, making a D.

letter-e.label: E
letter-e.hint: Point to the tip of the index finger.

letter-f.label: F
letter-f.hint: Two fingers laid across two fingers.

letter-h.label: H
letter-h.hint: Flat palm brushes across the other palm.

letter-i.label: I
letter-i.hint: Point to the tip of the middle finger.

letter-j.label: J
letter-j.hint: Start like I (middle fingertip), then draw a little hook down. Watch it at 0.5×.

letter-k.label: K
letter-k.hint: Dominant index curls over the top of the other hand's upright index finger.

letter-l.label: L
letter-l.hint: Index finger laid flat across the palm.

letter-m.label: M
letter-m.hint: Three fingers laid on the palm.

letter-n.label: N
letter-n.hint: Two fingers laid on the palm.

letter-o.label: O
letter-o.hint: Point to the tip of the ring finger.

letter-p.label: P
letter-p.hint: A thumb-and-index ring held at the tip of the other index finger.

letter-q.label: Q
letter-q.hint: The dominant hand hooks onto the other hand, like the tail of a Q. Watch it at 0.5×.

letter-r.label: R
letter-r.hint: Bent (crooked) index finger resting on the palm.

letter-t.label: T
letter-t.hint: Index fingertip touches the little-finger edge of the upright passive hand.

letter-u.label: U
letter-u.hint: Point to the tip of the little finger.

letter-v.label: V
letter-v.hint: V-shape (index + middle) pressed onto the palm.

letter-y.label: Y
letter-y.hint: Index finger laid into the web between thumb and index of the other hand.

letter-z.label: Z
letter-z.hint: Flat hand, palm down, against the heel of the other upright palm.

after.label: AFTER
after.hint: Southern: thumb-up hand moves forward from the other hand. Northern: index flicks forward. Watch at 0.5×.

afternoon.label: AFTERNOON
afternoon.hint: Five regional versions! SA: hand under the chin. Victoria: index near the chin. Tasmania: flat hand under the chin.

again.label: AGAIN
again.hint: Two-finger (V) hand flicks up. Also used as 'Pardon?'

age.label: AGE / HOW-OLD
age.hint: Hand in front of the nose, closing as it moves down. With raised eyebrows: 'How old?'

all.label: ALL
all.hint: Flat hand, palm down, sweeps around in a circle.

also.label: ALSO
also.hint: Dominant hand touches the second finger of the other hand, like listing a second item.

angry.label: ANGRY
angry.hint: Hand flicks out to the side with an angry face.

ask.label: ASK
ask.hint: Hand from the chin moves towards the person you're asking. Directional.

aunt.label: AUNT
aunt.hint: Two thumbs-up hands meet in front of the chest. Watch at 0.5×.

auslan.label: AUSLAN
auslan.hint: Both open hands, one at chest height and one up near the shoulder; the fingers flick and flutter.

autumn.label: AUTUMN / COOL
autumn.hint: Both hands, fingers spread, flutter down: leaves falling. Also means COOL.

baby.label: BABY
baby.hint: Arms cradle and rock a baby.

ball.label: BALL / ROUND
ball.hint: Southern: index fingers cross in front of the body. Northern: both curved hands shape a ball. SA: hands cupped.

beach.label: BEACH
beach.hint: Australia-wide: both hands make waves rolling in. Southern: the same sign as Northern YESTERDAY, so rely on context.

beard.label: BEARD
beard.hint: Both hands stroke down from the cheeks to the chin.

before.label: BEFORE
before.hint: Flat hand, palm back, moves back towards the shoulder: the past is behind you.

big.label: BIG
big.hint: Both curved hands move apart: showing a big size.

bike.label: BIKE
bike.hint: Both hands circle forward alternately: pedalling.

birthday.label: BIRTHDAY
birthday.hint: Five regional versions! Southern: both hands raised, palms out, shaking. WA: from the mouth, then the index points forward.

blue.label: BLUE
blue.hint: Southern: flat hand strokes the back of the other hand. Northern: two fingers rub the back of the hand.

bored.label: BORED
bored.hint: Thumb-and-finger ring at the chin flicks out; bored face.

boss.label: BOSS
boss.hint: V or bent fingers tap near the side of the forehead or shoulder.

both.label: BOTH
both.hint: Two-finger (V) hand moves between the two people.

box.label: BOX
box.hint: Both flat hands outline the sides, then top and bottom, of a box.

bread.label: BREAD
bread.hint: Flat hand slices across the other palm: cutting bread.

breakfast.label: BREAKFAST
breakfast.hint: Australia-wide: thumbs-up, then flat hand slides over the other: GOOD-MORNING + EAT. Southern: from the nose to a thumbs-up.

brother.label: BROTHER
brother.hint: Two fists side by side rub against each other.

brown.label: BROWN
brown.hint: Southern: fingers at the mouth. Northern: flat hand circles on the back of the other hand.

bus.label: BUS
bus.hint: Both hands curved, facing each other, showing a big vehicle shape. Watch at 0.5×.

busy.label: BUSY
busy.hint: Both fists, palms down, bounce in front of the body: hands busy working.

buy.label: BUY
buy.hint: Hand moves forward off the other palm, as if paying.

bye.label: BYE
bye.hint: Hand up beside the shoulder, fingers bend down and up together: a wave.

cafe.label: CAFÉ
cafe.hint: Hand at the chin with a small repeated movement. Watch at 0.5×.

can.label: CAN
can.hint: Bent index finger at the forehead or nose moves down to a fist. Watch at 0.5×.

cant.label: CAN'T
cant.hint: Index finger at the lips, then up and out with a headshake.

car.label: CAR
car.hint: Both fists move like turning a steering wheel. (Victoria: fists one above the other.)

cat.label: CAT
cat.hint: Thumb and index pinch at the cheek and pull out: whiskers.

child.label: CHILD
child.hint: Flat hand, palm down, pats at a child's height.

church.label: CHURCH
church.hint: Both flat hands raised, palms facing each other, moving down. Watch at 0.5×.

city.label: CITY
city.hint: Index fingers flick up alternately: tall buildings. Watch at 0.5×.

cloud.label: CLOUD
cloud.hint: Curved hands circle overhead: clouds rolling across the sky.

coffee.label: COFFEE
coffee.hint: Thumb and fingers in a C, tapping at the cheek.

cold.label: COLD / WINTER
cold.hint: Both fists shiver in front of the body. Also means WINTER.

colour.label: COLOUR
colour.hint: Fingers rub against the other hand (Australia-wide); index rubs the back of the hand (SA).

community.label: COMMUNITY
community.hint: Flat hands touch, then circle around in front of you: a group of people.

computer.label: COMPUTER
computer.hint: Both hands, fingertips together, move like a screen or keyboard. Watch at 0.5×.

cook.label: COOK
cook.hint: Fist stirs or flips over the other hand, like stirring a pot.

cousin.label: COUSIN
cousin.hint: Hand at the cheek with a small shaking movement. Watch at 0.5×.

cricket.label: CRICKET
cricket.hint: Both hands hold an imaginary bat and swing.

cry.label: CRY
cry.hint: Index fingers trace tears down the cheeks.

culture.label: CULTURE
culture.hint: Fingers interlock and turn. Watch at 0.5×.

daughter.label: DAUGHTER
daughter.hint: A short two-handed sign in front of the chest. Watch at 0.5×.

deaf.label: DEAF
deaf.hint: Index finger touches the ear, then the mouth.

deaf-club.label: DEAF-CLUB
deaf-club.hint: Both hands, fingers bent, interlocking at the chest. Watch at 0.5×.

dinner.label: DINNER
dinner.hint: Southern: hand at the chin moves down. Northern: the EAT sign. NSW: knife-and-fork movements.

doctor.label: DOCTOR
doctor.hint: Australia-wide: fingers tap the wrist, like taking a pulse. Southern: bent hand moves along the forearm.

dog.label: DOG
dog.hint: Both hands bent like paws in front of the chest: a begging dog.

dollar.label: DOLLAR
dollar.hint: Fingers brush across the upturned palm.

dont-know.label: DON'T-KNOW
dont-know.hint: Both hands out to the sides, palms up, with a shrug and a down-turned mouth.

drink.label: DRINK
drink.hint: Curved hand like holding a cup, tipped to the mouth.

drive.label: DRIVE
drive.hint: Both fists hold and turn a steering wheel.

early.label: EARLY
early.hint: Bent finger brushes the chin, then a thumbs-up. Watch at 0.5×.

eat.label: EAT / FOOD
eat.hint: Bunched fingertips move to the mouth: putting food in.

eight.label: EIGHT
eight.hint: Thumb plus two fingers, pointing sideways.

eighteen.label: EIGHTEEN
eighteen.hint: EIGHT handshape with an added movement.

eleven.label: ELEVEN
eleven.hint: Index-finger movement near the face (Australia-wide) or a flicking index (Southern). Watch at 0.5×.

everyone.label: EVERYONE
everyone.hint: Both index fingers up, sweeping round to everyone. Watch at 0.5×.

excited.label: EXCITED
excited.hint: Both hands brush up the chest alternately; bright face.

excuse-me.label: EXCUSE-ME
excuse-me.hint: Fingertips of one hand brush across the other palm.

family.label: FAMILY
family.hint: Both hands circle out and come together: a group.

far.label: FAR
far.hint: Hand moves away from you and out to the side; eyes narrow, maybe puff the cheeks.

favourite.label: FAVOURITE
favourite.hint: Thumb taps at the chin, while the other hand's index is up. Watch at 0.5×.

feel.label: FEEL
feel.hint: Bent middle finger brushes up the chest.

fifteen.label: FIFTEEN
fifteen.hint: FIVE handshape with an added movement.

finally.label: FINALLY / LAST
finally.hint: Index finger pointing up from beside the little finger of the other hand: 'last one'.

fingerspell.label: FINGERSPELL
fingerspell.hint: Both hands, fingers fluttering in front of the body, as if spelling.

finish.label: FINISH
finish.hint: Open hands, palms facing you, flip out and down: 'done, finished'. Also marks the past.

first.label: FIRST
first.hint: Thumb or index pops up from a fist: 'number one, first'.

follow.label: FOLLOW
follow.hint: One index finger follows behind the other hand.

football.label: FOOTBALL
football.hint: Hand kicks into the other: kicking a ball.

four.label: FOUR
four.hint: Four fingers up, thumb tucked in.

fourteen.label: FOURTEEN
fourteen.hint: FOUR handshape with an added movement.

free.label: FREE
free.hint: Both open hands, palms down, sweep apart.

friday.label: FRIDAY
friday.hint: The letter F (two fingers across two fingers) tapped.

friend.label: FRIEND
friend.hint: Hands clasped together in front of the body.

from.label: FROM
from.hint: Hand moves away from a starting point, as in 'come from'. Watch at 0.5×.

fruit.label: FRUIT
fruit.hint: Hand circles at the cheek, as if holding a round fruit, then to the chin.

fun.label: FUN
fun.hint: Australia-wide: bent index at the nose/cheek with a playful face. Northern: hand at the nose. Victoria: hand flicks at the forehead.

game.label: GAME
game.hint: Thumbs-up fists move against each other: competing.

give.label: GIVE
give.hint: Both hands move forward, palms up. The direction shows who gives to whom.

glasses.label: GLASSES
glasses.hint: Hand traces from beside the eye back to the ear, like the arm of a pair of glasses.

go.label: GO
go.hint: Open hand raised, then moves away from you.

good-morning.label: GOOD MORNING
good-morning.hint: Thumbs-up (GOOD) hand at the upper chest. The Northern and Southern versions differ slightly, so compare them at 0.25×.

grandfather.label: GRANDFATHER
grandfather.hint: Starts with a movement, then the F of FATHER. Compare with FATHER.

grandmother.label: GRANDMOTHER
grandmother.hint: Australia-wide: a two-handed sign in front of the chest. Southern: starts at the nose. Watch at 0.5×.

green.label: GREEN
green.hint: Australia-wide: flat hand brushes along the other forearm. Northern: hand at the temple.

grey.label: GREY
grey.hint: Australia-wide: flat hand on the cheek, the same sign as Southern PURPLE. SA: palms brush past each other.

hair.label: HAIR
hair.hint: Pinch a bit of hair at the side of your head.

happen.label: HAPPEN
happen.hint: Both hands cross and twist in front of the body. Watch at 0.5×.

happy.label: HAPPY
happy.hint: Flat hand brushes up the other palm repeatedly, with a smile.

have.label: HAVE
have.hint: Open hand closes into a fist, as if grasping.

he-she.label: HE / SHE / IT
he-she.hint: Point to where the person is, or to the spot you've set up for them.

hearing.label: HEARING
hearing.hint: Upright index finger beside the ear, small repeated movement.

hearing-aid.label: HEARING-AID
hearing-aid.hint: Bent index finger hooks behind the ear: wearing a hearing aid.

hello.label: HELLO
hello.hint: Flat hand starts beside the forehead and moves out and away, like a relaxed salute.

help.label: HELP
help.hint: Flat hand supports and lifts the other forearm. Direct it towards whoever's being helped.

history.label: HISTORY
history.hint: Hand rolls back over the shoulder repeatedly: going far back into the past.

holiday.label: HOLIDAY
holiday.hint: Australia-wide: open hands raised and shaken at the sides. SA: both hands flick out at chest height.

home.label: HOME
home.hint: Starts as a closed hand near the shoulder, then the open hand comes down. Watch at 0.5×.

hospital.label: HOSPITAL
hospital.hint: Southern: bent hand moves along the other forearm. Northern: hands at the chest. NSW: fingers at the forehead (a nurse's cap).

hot.label: HOT
hot.hint: Hand wipes from the mouth/chin outward, as if fanning heat away.

hour.label: HOUR
hour.hint: Flat hand circles in front of the face, then rests on the forehead. Watch at 0.5×.

house.label: HOUSE
house.hint: Both hands draw the roof and walls of a house.

how.label: HOW
how.hint: Southern: the backs of bent fingers roll against each other. Northern: hands open out, palms up.

how-are-you.label: GOOD / HOW ARE YOU?
how-are-you.hint: Thumbs-up in front of the chest. With raised eyebrows it asks 'How are you?'; with a nod it answers 'Good!'

how-many.label: HOW-MANY
how-many.hint: Open hand, fingers fluttering as if counting; eyebrows down.

how-much.label: HOW-MUCH / COST
how-much.hint: Fingers flutter in front of the chin; eyebrows down.

hundred.label: HUNDRED
hundred.hint: Signbank's video here is temporary. Watch it at 0.5×.

hungry.label: HUNGRY
hungry.hint: Four regional versions! Southern: thumbs-up hand at the stomach/chest. WA: open hand at the face closes. Northern: both hands on the stomach.

interpreter.label: INTERPRETER
interpreter.hint: Both thumb-and-finger rings swap back and forth: translating between two languages.

invite.label: INVITE
invite.hint: Open hand sweeps in towards you, palm up: 'come in'.

know.label: KNOW
know.hint: Thumb touches the side of the forehead.

last-week.label: LAST-WEEK
last-week.hint: Southern: index at the cheek, then moves back along the other hand: one week behind.

late.label: LATE
late.hint: Index finger points over the other hand, moving down.

later.label: LATER
later.hint: Index finger moves forward off the other palm: 'later on'.

laugh.label: LAUGH
laugh.hint: Hand at the chin with a small shaking movement, plus a laughing face.

learn.label: LEARN
learn.hint: Hand on the forehead, fingers draw together as it pulls away, as if taking knowledge in.

left.label: LEFT
left.hint: Hand moves to the left. Point or move towards your left side.

library.label: LIBRARY
library.hint: Flat hands move apart, like books on a shelf. Watch at 0.5×.

like.label: LIKE
like.hint: Flat hand brushes up the chest.

live.label: LIVE
live.hint: Australia-wide: thumbs-up hand moves down the chest. Tasmania: both open hands at the chest.

long.label: LONG
long.hint: Both fists pull apart sideways: showing length.

look.label: LOOK
look.hint: V-hand (eyes) moves from your eyes towards what you're looking at. Directional.

love.label: LOVE
love.hint: Arms crossed over the chest: a hug.

lunch.label: LUNCH
lunch.hint: Edge of the flat hand taps under the chin.

married.label: MARRIED
married.hint: One hand comes down onto the back of the other hand.

maybe.label: MAYBE
maybe.hint: Thumbs-up hand rocks from side to side.

me.label: ME
me.hint: Index finger points to the middle of your own chest.

meat.label: MEAT
meat.hint: Australia-wide: pinch the fleshy part of the other hand. Southern: index at the chin. Northern: from the cheek.

meet.label: MEET
meet.hint: Both hands come in from the sides and meet in front of the chest.

milk.label: MILK
milk.hint: Australia-wide: both fists squeeze alternately, like milking. NSW: hand near the mouth.

minute.label: MINUTE
minute.hint: Index finger moves a short way along the other hand: a small step on a clock.

monday.label: MONDAY
monday.hint: Hand moves across the front of the other upright hand. Watch at 0.5×.

money.label: MONEY
money.hint: Thumb rubs across the fingertips: the 'money' gesture.

mother.label: MOTHER
mother.hint: The letter M (three fingers) tapped on the palm.

movie.label: MOVIE
movie.hint: Australia-wide: open hand flickers against the other palm: a flickering screen. SA: both hands flicker.

music.label: MUSIC
music.hint: Index fingers wave in time, like conducting. (Signbank uses this same video for one Queensland BIRTHDAY.)

my.label: MY
my.hint: Closed fist placed against your chest.

name.label: NAME
name.hint: Index and middle fingers together touch the forehead, then move out to the side.

near.label: NEAR
near.hint: Two index-and-thumb hands move close together. Watch at 0.5×.

never.label: NEVER
never.hint: Flat hand with a sharp downward chop beside the other hand; firm headshake.

next-week.label: NEXT-WEEK
next-week.hint: Index finger moves forward along the other hand: one week ahead.

nice.label: NICE
nice.hint: Hand slides off the chin and finishes as a thumbs-up.

night.label: NIGHT
night.hint: Australia-wide: both flat hands cross in front of the body, closing in like darkness. Southern: V-hand at the eyes.

nine.label: NINE
nine.hint: Thumb plus three fingers, pointing sideways.

nineteen.label: NINETEEN
nineteen.hint: NINE handshape with an added movement.

no.label: NO
no.hint: Fingers snap shut onto the thumb; shake your head.

no-thanks.label: NO-THANKS / NO-WAY
no-thanks.hint: Open hand pushes out, palm forward: 'no way, no thanks'.

not.label: NOT
not.hint: Thumb and index ring flicks out from near the chin. Shake your head as well.

nothing.label: NOTHING
nothing.hint: Thumb and index ring held up, a small flick: 'zero, nothing'. Watch at 0.5×.

now.label: NOW / CURRENTLY
now.hint: Both open hands, palms up, drop slightly in front of you: 'right now, currently'.

number.label: NUMBER
number.hint: Bunched fingertips at the mouth with a small movement.

office.label: OFFICE
office.hint: Fist moves across the other palm, like writing or typing. Watch at 0.5×.

okay.label: OKAY
okay.hint: Open hand with a small side-to-side wobble: 'fine, okay'.

old.label: OLD
old.hint: Hand at the nose and chin closes as it moves down. Very similar to AGE.

orange.label: ORANGE
orange.hint: Hand squeezes open and closed in front of the mouth, like squeezing an orange.

our.label: OUR
our.hint: MY-style fist moves in an arc across the chest.

parents.label: PARENTS
parents.hint: Starts at the forehead, then the fingers tap the other hand (MOTHER/FATHER style).

pass.label: PASS (people)
pass.hint: Two upright index fingers (two people) move past each other.

pay.label: PAY
pay.hint: Thumb rubs fingertips (MONEY) then moves off the palm towards whoever's being paid.

phone.label: PHONE
phone.hint: Thumb and little finger out (an old handset) held to the ear.

pink.label: PINK
pink.hint: Index finger brushing the lips (Southern), or the chin (Northern). Watch at 0.5×.

plan.label: PLAN
plan.hint: Both hands with fingertips curled, move together in front of the body. Watch at 0.5×.

plane.label: PLANE
plane.hint: Thumb and little finger out (with index), moving up and away: a plane taking off.

play.label: PLAY
play.hint: Both open hands shake loosely at the sides.

please.label: PLEASE
please.hint: Southern: the same sign as THANK-YOU (flat hand from the chin). Northern: flat hand from the mouth, ending as a thumbs-up.

prefer.label: PREFER
prefer.hint: Flat hand brushes off the other palm, choosing one over the other.

purple.label: PURPLE
purple.hint: Southern: flat hand on the cheek (the same sign as Australia-wide GREY). WA: hand at the chin, fingers moving. Northern: index fingers rub together.

question.label: QUESTION / ASK
question.hint: Index finger moves against the raised fingers of the other hand. Watch at 0.5×.

rain.label: RAIN
rain.hint: Bent fingers move down in front of the body: rain falling.

read.label: READ
read.hint: V-hand (eyes) moves down across the other palm (a page).

ready.label: READY
ready.hint: Bent hand moves down and out, palm up.

red.label: RED
red.hint: Southern: index finger on the lips. Northern: hand brushes down from the chin.

remember.label: REMEMBER
remember.hint: Fist touches the forehead, then holds still. (SA: then both fists together at the chest.)

reply.label: REPLY
reply.hint: Index finger moves from the other hand towards someone: answering back.

right.label: RIGHT
right.hint: Hand moves to the right. Point or move towards your right side.

room.label: ROOM
room.hint: Both hands outline the walls of a room. Watch at 0.5×.

sad.label: SAD
sad.hint: Index finger drawn down from the mouth, with a sad face.

same.label: SAME
same.hint: Hand moves back and forth between you and the other person: 'me too, same'.

saturday.label: SATURDAY
saturday.hint: Bent fingers (a claw) at the chin, moving forward.

scared.label: SCARED
scared.hint: Flat hand on the chest; frightened face.

school.label: SCHOOL
school.hint: Australia-wide: flat hand at the side of the face. Northern: fist tapped on the back of the other hand.

see.label: SEE
see.hint: Index finger moves from the eye outwards.

see-you-again.label: SEE YOU AGAIN
see-you-again.english: see you later, see you again
see-you-again.hint: V-hand moves out from beside the eye, then the index points at the other person.

send.label: SEND
send.hint: Hand flicks off the other hand, away from you. Directional.

seven.label: SEVEN
seven.hint: Thumb plus index finger, index pointing sideways.

seventeen.label: SEVENTEEN
seventeen.hint: SEVEN handshape with an added movement.

shocked.label: SHOCKED
shocked.hint: Both hands move apart sharply; wide eyes, open mouth.

shop.label: SHOP
shop.hint: Fists brush against each other, as if handing over and receiving.

short.label: SHORT
short.hint: Flat hand moves down to a low height, palm down.

shout.label: SHOUT
shout.hint: Hand opens out from the mouth, like a loud voice.

show.label: SHOW
show.hint: Index finger points to the other palm, then moves towards the viewer. Directional.

shower.label: SHOWER
shower.hint: Hand above the head, fingers flicking down: water spraying.

sick.label: SICK
sick.hint: Touch the forehead, then the hands come together in front of the body.

sign.label: SIGN
sign.hint: Bent hands circle alternately in front of the chest.

sister.label: SISTER
sister.hint: Bent index finger rubs the side of the nose.

six.label: SIX
six.hint: Just the thumb, pointing up. (6–9 are built on the thumb.)

sixteen.label: SIXTEEN
sixteen.hint: SIX (thumb) handshape with an added movement.

sleep.label: SLEEP
sleep.hint: Thumb and fingers close in front of the eye: eyes closing.

slow.label: SLOW
slow.hint: One hand strokes slowly up the back of the other hand.

small.label: SMALL
small.hint: Both hands close together, showing a small size. (Southern starts from the mouth; NSW is near the mouth.)

soon.label: SOON
soon.hint: Thumb tip at the chin, then moves down and forward a little.

sorry.label: SORRY
sorry.hint: Australia-wide: curved hand at the chin with a small movement and a sorry face.

sport.label: SPORT
sport.hint: Thumbs-up hands with a small alternating movement.

spouse.label: HUSBAND / WIFE
spouse.hint: Touch the ring finger of the other hand, where a wedding ring goes.

spring.label: SPRING
spring.hint: Hand at the cheek, fingers opening. Signbank lists this one without a region. Watch at 0.5×.

square.label: SQUARE
square.hint: Index fingers trace a square in the air.

storm.label: STORM
storm.hint: Index finger zigzags down from above: lightning.

story.label: STORY
story.hint: Australia-wide: hand at the mouth/chin moves forward. Southern: the same sign as SIGN (Lesson 5), signing a story.

straight.label: STRAIGHT
straight.hint: Flat hand, palm sideways, moves straight forward.

student.label: STUDENT
student.hint: Hand from the forehead (LEARN) to the other palm.

study.label: STUDY
study.hint: Bent fingers wiggle above the other palm: reading and studying.

summer.label: SUMMER
summer.hint: Index finger wipes across the forehead: wiping off sweat.

sun.label: SUN
sun.hint: Fist above the head springs open: sun rays.

sunday.label: SUNDAY
sunday.hint: Both flat hands come together, palms touching, as if praying.

surprised.label: SURPRISED
surprised.hint: Flat hand on the chest, with wide eyes and raised eyebrows.

swim.label: SWIM
swim.hint: Arms move as if swimming freestyle.

table.label: TABLE / FLAT SURFACE
table.hint: Both flat hands, palms down, sweep apart: a flat surface.

tall.label: TALL
tall.hint: Flat hand raised high, palm down: showing someone's height.

tea.label: TEA
tea.hint: Fingertips together, small circular stirring above the other hand, like stirring a cuppa.

teacher.label: TEACHER
teacher.hint: Index finger moves forward from beside the head: passing knowledge on.

tell.label: TELL / SAY
tell.hint: Index from the lips moves towards the person you're telling. Directional.

ten.label: TEN
ten.hint: Closed hand springs open. Watch at 0.5×.

text-message.label: TEXT / EMAIL
text-message.hint: Both thumbs tap, like typing on a phone.

thank-you.label: THANK YOU
thank-you.hint: Flat hand from the chin moves forward and down towards the other person.

their.label: THEIR
their.hint: YOUR-style fist aimed at, and sweeping across, their location.

then.label: THEN
then.hint: Both open hands close and open in front of you, marking the next step. Watch at 0.5×.

they.label: THEY
they.hint: Index sweeps across the places where those people are.

thin.label: THIN (object)
thin.hint: Flat hand moves down in front of the body: describing something thin and tall.

thirsty.label: THIRSTY
thirsty.hint: Index finger traces down the throat.

thirteen.label: THIRTEEN
thirteen.hint: THREE handshape with an added movement.

thousand.label: THOUSAND
thousand.hint: Index up (ONE), then the hand drops open. Watch at 0.5×.

three.label: THREE
three.hint: Index, middle and ring fingers up.

thursday.label: THURSDAY
thursday.hint: Both flat hands, bent at the knuckles, with a small movement side by side. Watch at 0.5×.

time.label: TIME
time.hint: Index finger taps the back of the other wrist: where a watch goes.

tired.label: TIRED
tired.hint: Bent hand at the chest drops down; tired face, slumped shoulders.

today.label: TODAY / NOW
today.hint: Australia-wide: index finger held up, small downward movement (also means NOW). Northern: flat hands at the chest.

together.label: TOGETHER / WITH
together.hint: Both hands come together and touch, moving as one.

toilet.label: TOILET
toilet.hint: Australia-wide: letter T on the hand (same as TUESDAY). Victoria: W at the chin (the same sign as Southern WATER). SA: index flicks.

tomorrow.label: TOMORROW
tomorrow.hint: Index finger at the cheek, moving forward: the future is in front of you.

train.label: TRAIN
train.hint: Fist moves in a circle beside the body, like a train's wheel.

travel.label: TRAVEL
travel.hint: Both index fingers point forward and move away together.

tuesday.label: TUESDAY
tuesday.hint: Index finger touches the side of the other upright hand: the letter T. (TOILET uses the same sign.)

twelve.label: TWELVE
twelve.hint: Two-finger hand with a flicking movement. The Southern form also means 'dozen'. Watch at 0.5×.

uncle.label: UNCLE
uncle.hint: Both hands at the chest, fingertips meeting. Watch at 0.5×.

understand.label: UNDERSTAND
understand.hint: Index finger at the temple flicks up and away, like an idea landing.

university.label: UNIVERSITY
university.hint: Both index fingers point up beside the head: a mortarboard.

vehicles-pass.label: PASS (vehicles)
vehicles-pass.hint: Two flat hands (vehicles) slide past each other.

very.label: VERY
very.hint: Australia-wide: both hands with a strong, tense movement. Southern: from the chin. Puff your cheeks for emphasis.

wait.label: WAIT / HOLD-ON
wait.hint: Index finger held up: 'hang on a moment'.

walk.label: WALK
walk.hint: Two fingers walk along the other palm. (Victoria: the hand swings forward.)

want.label: WANT
want.hint: Australia-wide: flat hand on the chest moves out, palm up. SA: palm-up hand pulls towards you.

water.label: WATER
water.hint: Southern: thumb and index tap at the chin, like the letter W. Northern: flat hand at the mouth.

we.label: WE / US
we.hint: Index sweeps around to include you and the people with you.

weather.label: WEATHER
weather.hint: Both open hands raised, palms out, wiggling.

week.label: WEEK / WEDNESDAY
week.hint: Fingers of both hands interlock: the letter W. WEEK and WEDNESDAY share this sign.

weekend.label: WEEKEND
weekend.hint: Both hands with crossed fingers near the chest, moving down. Watch at 0.5×.

what.label: WHAT
what.hint: Index finger up, small side-to-side shake, eyebrows down.

when.label: WHEN
when.hint: Fingers against the cheek, fluttering as if counting; eyebrows down.

where.label: WHERE
where.hint: Both hands palm-up, moving out to the sides; eyebrows down.

which.label: WHICH
which.hint: Thumb and little finger out, rocking side to side between choices.

white.label: WHITE
white.hint: Australia-wide: fingers flick near the face. WA: from the chin, then the index flicks up. Northern: index at the chest.

who.label: WHO
who.hint: Upright index finger with a small movement; eyebrows down.

why.label: WHY
why.hint: Flat hand, palm down; the fingers bend down. Eyebrows down.

wide.label: WIDE
wide.hint: Both flat hands, palms facing, move wide apart.

wind.label: WIND
wind.hint: Both open hands sway from side to side: wind blowing.

work.label: WORK / JOB
work.hint: Flat hand taps the edge of the other hand repeatedly.

worried.label: WORRIED
worried.hint: Hand at the side of the forehead with a small, repeated movement; worried face.

year.label: YEAR
year.hint: Index circles around the other hand: one trip around the sun.

yellow.label: YELLOW
yellow.hint: Southern: thumb-and-finger ring at the temple. Northern: index points and flicks at the temple.

yes.label: YES
yes.hint: A nodding hand (see the video), and nod your head too.

yesterday.label: YESTERDAY
yesterday.hint: Southern: index finger at the cheek/chin, moving back over the shoulder. Northern: hand at the chin moves back.

you.label: YOU
you.hint: Index finger points at the person you're talking to.

young.label: YOUNG
young.hint: Bent index finger brushes near the mouth/nose. Watch at 0.5×.

your.label: YOUR
your.hint: Closed fist pushed towards the other person.

zero.label: ZERO
zero.hint: Thumb and fingertips meet in an O shape, held up beside the shoulder.
